sources.title: Developmental Robotics: Theory and Experiments
sources.access: Public author paper indexed text; institutional bibliography listed PDF but open returned 502

implemented: SAIL and Dav robots; author reports attention, navigation, speech, obstacle avoidance and action chaining experiments.
learned: Task representations developed through sensory interaction including human teaching.
designed: Innate developmental mechanisms, robot sensors and effectors supplied.
limit: No full-method or independent generality test; no organismal heredity demonstrated.
ora: Distinguish task-specific representation acquisition from origin of the developmental algorithm.
funding: NSF IIS 9815191; DARPA ETO DAAN02-98-C-4025; DARPA ITO DABT63-99-1-0014; MSU Strategic Partnership Grant; Microsoft Research and Zyvex gifts: indexed author acknowledgement p.232, not image authenticated or award-file verified
rights: Metadata and original analysis only; no source redistribution.

sources.title: Cognitive programs: software for attention's executive
sources.access: Public article metadata; contextualized by author keynote at ECEM 2015 https://ecem2015.univie.ac.at/about-ecem-2015/invited-speakers/john-k-tsotsos/index.htm

implemented: Selective Tuning Attentive Reference model described by creator as early-stage integration of executive control, memory, perception and gaze selection in 2015.
learned: Autonomous learning of attention policy not verified in this pass.
designed: Multiple saliency and task-dependent selection mechanisms supplied.
limit: Integration objective not evidence of flexible general visual task execution; quantitative experiments not reviewed.
ora: Measure the cost and behavioral advantage of selectively processing information.
rights: Metadata and original analysis only; no source redistribution.

sources.title: Acquisition of concepts and causal rules in SHRUTI
sources.access: Institutional proceedings indexed text and author-posted text; direct open did not expose article body

implemented: Neural circuit model of relational knowledge and rule acquisition.
learned: Authors describe learning relational concepts and causal rules through two specified learning mechanisms.
designed: Causal Hebbian and recruitment learning mechanisms and representational circuitry designed.
limit: No full-method verification of generalization, autonomous development or resource cost.
ora: Distinguish learning relations from evolution of the machinery that supports relational learning.
rights: Metadata and original analysis only; no source redistribution.

sources.authors: Paul S. Rosenbloom; Abram Demski; Volkan Ustun
sources.title: The Sigma Cognitive Architecture and System: Towards Functionally Elegant Grand Unification
sources.institution: USC Institute for Creative Technologies / JAGI
sources.access: CC BY 3.0; first page visually verified; selected text sections 4.2.4, 6.2, 7, 8.1; p.91 screenshot failed

implemented: Graphical representation unifies multiple inference and learning idioms; virtual human examples.
learned: Gradient descent updates functions in supplied graphical structures; authors report learning concepts, maps and action models.
designed: Graph structure, learning algorithm, conditionals and scenario scaffolding supplied.
limit: Authors explicitly report no structural graph learning in 2016 and gaps in motivation, bodily state, motor control; external fast decisions delegated to SmartBody.
ora: Separate adaptive parameters from acquisition of the processing structure and account for external helper computation.
rights: Metadata and original analysis only; no source redistribution.

implemented: Chapter identity and intended combination of situated and planned action confirmed; implementation details not established.

sources.title: Communicative humanoids : a computational model of psychosocial dialogue skills
sources.access: Official thesis metadata and author abstract https://alumni.media.mit.edu/~kris/thesis.html ; MIT prohibits redistribution without permission

implemented: Gandalf prototype combines gestures, speech and perceptual processing in a solar-system dialogue task; author reports user interaction.
learned: Acquisition of dialogue skills not established by abstract.
designed: Distributed dialogue, perception and decision machinery supplied.
limit: No general communication learning, independent objectives or subjective experience established.
ora: Separate competent expression from origin of competence.
rights: Metadata and original analysis only; no source redistribution.

sources.title: Shadows and Headless Shadows: an Autobiographical Approach to Narrative Reasoning
sources.access: Public author preprint abstract; full methods not reviewed

implemented: Story-oriented system uses stored events to align current narrative and predict or infer missing events.
learned: Acquires event history; independent acquisition of the inference machinery not established.
designed: Event representation and shadowing/extrapolation mechanisms supplied.
limit: Narrative confabulation is not factual verification; no organism-level inheritance demonstrated.
ora: Distinguish memory retrieval, prediction and accuracy of inferred events.
rights: Metadata and original analysis only; no source redistribution.
